summary: Iteration 41 — News tap-through Reader + BigCoin read reward + Explore iconized filters + AdBanner between sections. Backend pytest 8/8 pass (POST /api/news/read: first read of a unique headline_id returns awarded:true, points:1, balance_after present, daily_count:1, daily_cap:10; same headline_id repeat returns awarded:false, points:0; after firing 15 unique headline_ids in a row, daily_count is correctly clamped at 10 with awarded:false/points:0 on subsequent calls; regression: /api/news/headlines (live NewsAPI fallback with source_name+headline_text) 200, /api/news/local-strip 200 with {city, weather, prayer}, /api/promoted/stations 200, /api/promoted/leaderboard?days=7 200, /api/banner/serve?zone=browse_row 200 for non-premium demo). Mobile (Expo web preview @ 390x844): 'Try the demo' logs in and lands on /home showing 'RadioLife.app' wordmark + 'Welcome back, Demo · DIL SE · DALLAS SE' + BREAKING card + BIGCOIN BALANCE 137 BRONZE + FEATURED STATIONS + TOP PLAYED STATIONS. News tab: news-local-strip renders ('Council Bluffs · Dhuhr 13:29'); breaking cards (5 news-breaking-*) + headline cards (8 news-card-*); tapping the first news-card navigates to /news-article with all query params (headline_id, title, summary, source_name, source_url, image_url, published_at, category) → news-article-screen renders with hero image, TOP category badge, title ('Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is stepping down - axios.com'), Axios source · 8/5/2026, summary, and 'Read full article' button (news-article-open-original); news-article-reward Animated.View is mounted (renders '+0 BigCoin for reading' when cap hit — animation gated on awarded && points>0 so it stays invisible with opacity 0 in the capped case; on a fresh day/user it fires with +1). AdBanner zone=browse_row correctly renders NOTHING when no live campaign matches (per spec — 'no empty ad box' is correct). Stations/Explore screen: 3 labeled iconized filter rows visible (earth/orange for Country, language/orange for Language, musical-notes/orange for Genre); all chips readable (Country: All/UAE/India/USA/UK/Pakistan/Saudi/Germany; Language: All/Hindi/English/Arabic/Urdu/Punjabi/Tamil/Malayalam; Genre: All/Bollywood/Punjabi/Hindi/News/Talk/Sports/Devotional/Pop/Rock/Edm/Classical/Jazz); selecting Genre=Bollywood reduces header total from '2,012 live stations worldwide' → '261 live stations worldwide' confirming server-side filter is wired. Games tab loads (no 'Couldn't load games' — regression clean). Web surface not tested (feature scope is mobile-only per problem statement — 'Mobile Explore / Mobile News / Mobile ads/premium').

action_items: LOW/COSMETIC: Fix Genre chip 'Edm' → 'EDM' (acronym) in /app/mobile/app/stations.tsx:297 — small capitalization override map.

LOW: Dedupe sponsored vs browse rows on Stations screen (React 'duplicate keys' warning) — either filter out promoted.id from the browse items in the list, or namespace the key with a 'sponsored:' prefix. Reference: /app/mobile/app/stations.tsx:313 (keyExtractor).

OPTIONAL: In /app/mobile/app/news-article.tsx the reward toast Animated.View is always mounted (testID always visible in DOM tree) even when awarded=false — this is intentional (opacity fade stays at 0) but a testing agent may misread '+0 BigCoin' as a bug. Consider only mounting when reward !== null, or move the '+N' label into a computed string that hides when N===0.

OPTIONAL: /api/news/read uses a read-then-write pattern (find_one + update_one $inc) — under high concurrency two writes could each read count<cap and both increment past cap by 1. Consider a single findOneAndUpdate with a $expr conditional on count<cap+len(awarded_ids) or use the returned document's post-inc count instead of the pre-write snapshot. Reference: /app/backend/routes/news_phase_r.py:106-127.

OPTIONAL: NEWS_READ_REWARD (1) and NEWS_READ_DAILY_CAP (10) are hardcoded module constants — consider moving to a settings collection or ENV so ops can tune without a deploy. Reference: /app/backend/routes/news_phase_r.py:24-25.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/news/read has a small consistency edge: `already` is checked against awarded_ids from the pre-update snapshot, so two concurrent POSTs for the same headline_id can both pass the `not already` check and both call bigcoin.award — awarding 2 BigCoin for 1 article. Mongo's $addToSet will dedupe the id but the double credit already happened. Consider a compare-and-set via findOneAndUpdate({user_id, date, awarded_ids:{$ne:key}, count:{$lt:CAP}}, {$inc:{count:1}, $addToSet:{awarded_ids:key}}) and only award BigCoin if the returned doc was modified.

/api/news/read persists an anon key `anon_{count}` when body.headline_id AND body.title are both empty — this means an unauthenticated-style call with no identifiers still consumes a slot toward the cap. Ok as anti-abuse but should reject with 400 for cleanliness so clients don't accidentally burn cap on empty payloads.

AdBanner impressions fire on mount regardless of whether the banner is actually visible in the viewport — for a browse_row placement inside a ScrollView, this may over-count impressions vs sponsors' expectations. Consider gating impression fire on onLayout + IntersectionObserver (or a scroll-based visible check). Reference: /app/mobile/src/components/AdBanner.tsx:32-37.

news-article.tsx: WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync opens an external browser; when the user returns to the app, no state cleanup happens — fine on mobile native, but on web preview it opens a new tab so useEffect-based reward call doesn't re-fire (correct). Just call out.

news-article.tsx passes headline_id/title/summary etc. as ROUTE PARAMS (URL query string) — long summaries + image URLs blow up the URL length (screenshot shows ~450 chars). Consider passing headline_id only and re-fetching from /api/news/headlines/:id (would need a new endpoint) or from an in-memory store. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/news.tsx:12-24.
MOCKED: none in scope for iter41. All rewards flow through the real bigcoin service and Mongo news_read_rewards collection.
test_credentials: Mobile: 'Try the demo' (testID demo-login-btn). Demo user is non-premium (is_premium:false, premium_tier:null) — ad-banner is code-eligible.
seed_data_creation: Backend test fires 3 + 15 = ~18 unique headline_id reads under the demo user; this pushes today's news_read_rewards.count to 10 (capped) and populates awarded_ids with TEST_iter41_* entries. Side-effect: the mobile UI news-article visited right after backend tests will observe awarded:false points:0 (cap already reached) — toast opacity stays 0 (invisible), which is CORRECT behavior. To visually see the '+1 BigCoin' toast, delete today's news_read_rewards doc for this demo user_id or run this test suite on a fresh day.
